title: withdrawal/v1
description: nodes/<id>/withdrawals/<timestamp>-<curator>.yaml (F08-T31; D-14, D-18 v3.27): a listed curator withdraws one status record or one defect claim of the same node, with a reason, reviewed like any curator record (F08-R8). Append-only. The withdrawn file stays in the tree and every reader of status records and defect claims reads it as absent; a disputed status lifts when its record, or the claim its reference names, is withdrawn. No date is compared: a withdrawal applies because it is on the record. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

withdraws.description: The record withdrawn, relative to this node's directory: status/<file> (a node-status record) or defects/<file> (a defect claim against this node).

reason.description: Why, in the curator's words: the published reasoning a withdrawal owes the record (D-22).
